runtimeCoverageGuard: Every private file read during all five generator checks must belong to this inventory and match its exact pin, including reads whose failure an adapter would otherwise catch. Missing sources are aggregated before any generator executes.

Corpus catalog entries not opened by these generators are discovery inventory, not additional original bytes to download.
